sources.title: nllb-200-distilled-600M: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: nllb-200-distilled-600M is a multilingual machine translation model that translates text between 200 languages, maintained by facebook. This 600 million parameter distilled variant prioritizes speed and efficiency over the larger NLLB-200 models while retaining broad language coverage.
